How do you add banners like that in your overview?

[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;60185358]How do you add banners like that in your overview?[/quote]
Use the traditional [img][/img], find an image you think would be good for a banner, and then resize/crop it to 1532 x 312.
https://imageresizer.com/ works pretty well for that although I mostly suggest cropping it aswell if it doesn't come out good

[quote=camphill;60185377]I can't even put images in my factbooks. 😧[/quote]
Just do [img][/img] and then right click an image for its image address, which usually looks like this https://i.imgur.com/guhdSbo.jpeg

(example: [img]https://i.imgur.com/guhdSbo.jpeg[/img]) And it should work, usually using an image uploading website like https://imgur.com/ or https://imgbb.com/ helps in doing that as well as long as you download the image to your computer to then upload to those sites

[quote=camphill;60185377]I can't even put images in my factbooks. 😧[/quote]
Depending on what image site you are using you might have to do some "sillines" to get it to give you a usable page/image link
On imgbb for example you have to click the picture, then open that enlarged picture in a new tab and then open the picture in this new tab ones more in a new tab to make it work (you will get a progresivly more complex page info/link in the different tabs) don't know why it is like this but that is how it is :|
